general.standard_conclusion: Standard Companion's gameplay is pretty straightforward: you utilise his skills to get buffs while adapting your gameplay based on the standard weapon you have chosen.

king_of_darknight.paragraph_1: King of Darknight is a controlled, methodical companion who cycles between two phases:
king_of_darknight.ul_li_1: Outside [Darknight Reign]: Build [Last Words] stacks → consume them with [Final Elegy] (Active Skill) to gain [Lumenflora Stamen] and reduce Reign cooldown.
king_of_darknight.ul_li_2: Inside [Darknight Reign]: Spend your [Stamens] to reduce initial cooldown of your special Active Skill [The Chosen One's Blessing], then spam it and the empowered Support Skill [Royal Seal] for burst damage.
king_of_darknight.li_1: Accumulate [Last Words]: wait for passive generation OR use [Royal Seal] (Support Skill) to get 1 stack instantly.
king_of_darknight.li_2: Cast [Final Elegy] (Active Skill): consumes 1 [Last Words] → reduces [Darknight Coronation] cooldown by 4s → gives 1 [Lumenflora Stamen].
king_of_darknight.li_3: Within 2.7s, cast [Final Elegy] again (enhanced version) it consumes another [Last Words] → another stack.
king_of_darknight.li_4: Repeat until you have 3 [Stamens] and [Darknight Coronation] is ready.
king_of_darknight.paragraph_5: Best timing: When the enemy's shield is broken or nearly broken. Press the [Darknight Coronation] button.
king_of_darknight.paragraph_7: Cooldown after use: 30s (reduced by consuming [Last Words])
king_of_darknight.ul_li_3: Your Active Skill becomes [The Chosen One's Blessing]
king_of_darknight.ul_li_4: [Royal Seal] becomes empowered (cannot trigger the normal empowered version, but blooms extra Lumenflora)
king_of_darknight.ul_li_5: Each [Lumenflora Stamen] you have reduces the initial cooldown of [The Chosen One's Blessing] by 3.4s (up to 10.2s with 3 stacks)
king_of_darknight.paragraph_10: Goal: Spam [The Chosen One's Blessing] and [Royal Seal] as many times as possible within 9 seconds.
king_of_darknight.rotationstring: [The Chosen One's Blessing] ⇨ [Royal Seal] ⇨ [The Chosen One's Blessing] ⇨ [Royal Seal] ⇨ repeat
king_of_darknight.ul_li_6: [The Chosen One's Blessing] creates [Radiant Ripples] under you (AoE damage). Can be cast up to 3 times per Reign.
king_of_darknight.ul_li_7: [Royal Seal] blooms additional Lumenflora, dealing big AoE damage.
king_of_darknight.paragraph_11: At R1+: During Reign, you become unstoppable and [Radiant Ripples] damage increases by 40%. The Support Skill cooldown resets when you create Ripples.
king_of_darknight.paragraph_12: At R3: Xavier also creates [Radiant Ripples] when you do, and each Ripple undulation increases [Lumenflora] damage by 6% (up to 36%) during Reign.
king_of_darknight.rotation_1: OUTSIDE REIGN: Build [Last Words] (wait or use [Royal Seal]) ⇨ [Final Elegy] (consumes 1) ⇨ Enhanced [Final Elegy] (consumes another) ⇨ repeat until 3 [Stamens] and [Darknight Coronation] ready
king_of_darknight.rotation_2: WAIT for enemy shield to break (or almost break)
king_of_darknight.rotation_4: INSIDE REIGN: [The Chosen One's Blessing] ⇨ [Royal Seal] ⇨ repeat up to 3 times ⇨ Use [Royal Decree] (Ardent Oath) if available
king_of_darknight.rotation_5: REIGN ENDS ⇨ Return to OUTSIDE (cooldown 30s, reduced by your setup)

god_of_annihilation.paragraph_1: God of Annihilation is a resource stacking & burst transformation companion. You build [Golden Arrows] through [Basic Attack]s, fire them with [Charged Attack] to stack [Arrow Mark], remove Zayne's [Divine Shackles], then enter [Deity of Niava] for 10 seconds of empowered damage.
god_of_annihilation.paragraph_3: Goal: Remove 3 [Divine Shackles] as fast as possible.
god_of_annihilation.li_3: [Charged Attack] → fires all arrows → each hit applies [Arrow Mark]
god_of_annihilation.li_4: At 4 stacks → [Arrow Mark] consumed → removes 1 shackle + Zayne fires [Terminus Arrow] (heals!)
god_of_annihilation.li_5: [Active Skill] ([Divine Judgment]) → converts any [Remnant Feathers] back to arrows
god_of_annihilation.li_6: Within 4s, use free [Divine Slash] (no Energy cost) → fires all arrows again
god_of_annihilation.li_7: Repeat steps 1-6 until all 3 shackles are gone
god_of_annihilation.paragraph_4: Pro tip: Use [Divinity Order] ([Resonance Skill]) to gather enemies so your [Charged Attack] hits multiple at once.
god_of_annihilation.ul_li_2: Your [Charged Attack] shatters [Soul Rifts] for big damage
god_of_annihilation.ul_li_3: [Endbringer Arrow] becomes [Divine Sever] (counts as [Charged Attack] damage)
god_of_annihilation.ul_li_5: You and Zayne deal +8% DMG (from Starting Effect)
god_of_annihilation.paragraph_9: Goal: Shatter as many [Soul Rifts] as possible within 10 seconds.
god_of_annihilation.rotation_2: [Divine Sever] (refresh by shattering) → deals [Charged Attack] damage
god_of_annihilation.paragraph_11: At R1+: [Basic Attack]s can also shatter [Soul Rifts]. [Divine Sever] creates an extra array that pulls enemies and explodes.
god_of_annihilation.paragraph_12: At R3: Enemies hit by [Terminus Arrow] or [Divine Sever] take 30% more damage for 4s.
god_of_annihilation.rotation_5: [Charged Attack] → fire all arrows → apply [Arrow Mark]
god_of_annihilation.rotation_9: During [Deity of Niava]: [Charged Attack] → shatter [Soul Rifts] for bonus damage

artist.paragraph: [Resonance Skill] and [Support Skill] create [Scarlet Shade] and [Flame Lily] which inflict [Burn] for 5s. After consuming 10 [Flame Lilies], Rafayel gets an ATK buff for 10s and additionally his attack range is also increased. To create more [Flame Lilies] and trigger the [Passive Skill] faster you can use a high-speed weapon like [Hunter Firearm].

fresh_paint.paragraph: [Charged Attack] and [Support Skill] inflict [Tinctus] stacking it up to 5 times. Detonate them, dealing ATK DMG based on the number of stacks and restoring HP to both of you. Detonating 5 stacks reduces enemy DEF by 20% for 5s. To inflict more [Tinctus], use high-speed weapon like [Hunter Firearm].

phantom_of_the_siren.paragraph: [Support Skill] leaves behind [Reprise] which reduces enemy movement speed by 50% for 5s. Using [Support Skill] after triggering [Passive Skill] leaves [Echo] which increases the DMG dealt to enemies by 10% for 5s. To utilize it faster, use high a speed-weapon like [Hunter Firearm].

abysswalker.paragraph_1: Abysswalker has a special skill called [Potential]. It requires 6 stacks.  You can find it under the HP bar.
abysswalker.paragraph_2: You can collect those by using a [Charged Attack] when you see a [Beacon] on the enemy or by collecting a [Fishtail Beacon] that appears after using a [Support Skill]:
abysswalker.paragraph_3: Triggering [Potential] by collecting all 6 stacks consumes them and increases CRIT Rate by 15% for 5s and allows Rafayel to deal big DMG to an enemy.
abysswalker.paragraph_4: You can also see buffs being applied on your [MC] above your HP bar and his buffs near his icon:
abysswalker.paragraph_5: For Abysswalker there's no actual rotation but in a nutshell:
abysswalker.li_3: after [Support Skill], wait for [Beacon] to collect
abysswalker.li_4: use [Resonance Skill] to pull enemies (and break the shield)

god_of_the_tides.paragraph_1: Your main priorities with God of the Tides in the battle are:
god_of_the_tides.li_1: Building [Faith]: attack with [MC], Rafayel and [Sea Spirits]
god_of_the_tides.li_2: At full [Faith] triggering [Heavenly Rain] (+30% DMG, [Sea Spirits] levels up)
god_of_the_tides.li_3: [Active Skill] (CRIT Rate [Tidal Field], stay inside it)
god_of_the_tides.li_4: [Basic Attack]s + [Support Skill] + [Perfect Dodge] (To create as many [Sea Spirits] as possible and restore [Faith])
god_of_the_tides.paragraph_3: Remember to time your main sources of DMG with enemies' shields which can only be broken by [Resonance Skill]. You can always check if buffs are active above your HP bar and near his icon.
god_of_the_tides.paragraph_4: [Sea Spirit] has 3 levels. Their level can be increased by [Passive Skill] and at Rank 1:
god_of_the_tides.li_6: does DMG based on ATK + HP.

lemurian_sea_god.paragraph_1: Lemurian Sea God may seem quite complex at first but his rotations are quite straightforward and improve with Ranks.
lemurian_sea_god.paragraph_2: Your gameplay is centred around [Sea God Mark] and his special state. When a [Charged Attack] empowered by [Sea God Mark] hits an enemy, it reduces the [Support Skill] cooldown by 1.5s.
lemurian_sea_god.paragraph_3: He has two states: normal and [Divine Favor] which can be activated by reaching [Ocean's Descent]. To activate it you need to perform [Basic Attack]s and [Active Skill] to fill the yellow part of the bar. To full Rafayel's white part of it you should click on his icon when his [Support Skill] is up and to trigger it faster, you can perform a [Perfect Dodge].
lemurian_sea_god.paragraph_4: When [Ocean's Descent] is full, a button will appear. When triggered, it will change the state to  [Divine Favor] for 11s. In this state, Rafayel will throw lightning. And you are the main star right now!
lemurian_sea_god.paragraph_5: Consuming [Sea God Mark] is greatly empowered in this state. Additionally, [Active Skill]  will generate [Lightning Crystal], dodging right into it will detonate it dealing massive DMG and restoring 0.3 ◆  also reducing [Active Skill] cooldown by 3.3s! When state ends, any remaining [Lightning Crystal] will detonate automatically.
lemurian_sea_god.paragraph_6: Usually you are able to make the rotation 3 times during the [Divine Favor], with Ranks it is possible to do up to 4!
lemurian_sea_god.paragraph_7: So the whole rotation will look like this:
lemurian_sea_god.ul_li_1: [Resonance Skill] + use MC's [Basic Attack] & [Active Skill] to stack (don't consume [Sea God Mark] too close to state change) + Rafayel's [Support Skill] +  [Resonance Skill]  ⇨
lemurian_sea_god.ul_li_3: consume [Sea God Mark] + [Active Skill] leaves behind  [Lightning Crystal] + dodge into it (repeat till the end) ⇨
lemurian_sea_god.paragraph_8: If you have time between  before [Sea God Mark] restorations you can do [Basic Attack]s.

vermilion_martial_god.paragraph_1: Vermilion Martial God is a two-phase burst transformation companion. You build [Martial Intent] and charge [Vermilion Visage] outside [Martial Soul], then enter a high-damage burst window with new skills. The loop: build resources → transform → spend [Vermilion Flare] → end with [Crushing Descent] → repeat.
vermilion_martial_god.paragraph_2: You have three main resources to track:
vermilion_martial_god.ul_li_1: [Martial Intent] — accumulated by Charged Attacks; empowers Active Skill (+50% DMG)
vermilion_martial_god.ul_li_2: [Vermilion Visage] — energy bar charged by Active Skills; full = transform
vermilion_martial_god.ul_li_3: [Vermilion Flare] — burst resource during Martial Soul (max 3); spent on [Warflame Cleave]
vermilion_martial_god.paragraph_3: How to build resources outside [Martial Soul]:

table_1.table_row_1_applies: Accumulates [Martial Intent] (full = empower next Active Skill)
table_1.table_row_2_applies: If [Martial Intent] full → +50% DMG + charges [Vermilion Visage]

vermilion_martial_god.paragraph_4: When [Vermilion Visage] is full, [Martial God's Descent] becomes available — press it to enter [Martial Soul].
vermilion_martial_god.rotationstring: [Charged Attack] → [Severed Grace] → [Sweeping Clouds] → repeat until [Vermilion Visage] full → [Martial God's Descent]
vermilion_martial_god.li_2: [Severed Grace] ([Active Skill]) → empowered (+50% DMG) + charges [Vermilion Visage]
vermilion_martial_god.li_3: [Sweeping Clouds] ([Support Skill]) → charges [Vermilion Visage] on cooldown
vermilion_martial_god.li_4: Repeat until [Vermilion Visage] is full → [Martial God's Descent] appears
vermilion_martial_god.paragraph_6: Build resources efficiently to enter [Martial Soul] as quickly as possible.
vermilion_martial_god.paragraph_7: Martial Soul (Burst Window): During [Martial Soul], your skills change:
vermilion_martial_god.rotationstring2: [Sundering Thrust] (build [Vermilion Flare]) → [Warflame Cleave] (costs 3 Flare → [Martial Fall]) → Basic/Charged Attacks (build Flare again) → repeat → [Crushing Descent] (ends Soul + [Martial Fall])
vermilion_martial_god.paragraph_8: Inside [Martial Soul], [Vermilion Visage] energy drains — you gain +25% DMG while it lasts. Use [Sundering Thrust] to build [Vermilion Flare], spend it on [Warflame Cleave] for [Martial Fall] damage, then end with [Crushing Descent].
vermilion_martial_god.li_10: [Martial Fall] — single-target damage from [Warflame Cleave] or [Crushing Descent]
vermilion_martial_god.li_11: [Ashen Duskfall] — replaces [Martial Fall] if [Vermilion Visage] has energy; AoE damage (first hit full, rest reduced to 30%)
vermilion_martial_god.paragraph_12: Setup Phase: build [Martial Intent] and charge [Vermilion Visage]:
vermilion_martial_god.paragraph_12_1: You can also try starting the battle by using Active Skill without any charges buff to get faster into a [Martial Soul]
vermilion_martial_god.rotationstring3: [Resonance Skill] (optional, for shield break/gathering) → [Charged Attack] (build [Martial Intent]) → [Severed Grace] (empowered, charges [Visage]) → [Sweeping Clouds] (charges [Visage]) → repeat until [Vermilion Visage] full → [Martial God's Descent] → [Martial Soul]
vermilion_martial_god.paragraph_13: Burst Phase: inside [Martial Soul], spend [Flare] and end with [Crushing Descent]:
vermilion_martial_god.rotationstring4: [Warflame Cleave] (spend 3 [Flare] → [Martial Fall]) → [Sundering Thrust] (build [Flare]) → [Basic Attacks] (build [Flare] faster) → repeat → [Crushing Descent] (ends [Soul] + [Martial Fall]/[Ashen Duskfall]) → repeat the whole rotation ↺
vermilion_martial_god.paragraph_14: At R1+: Start with full [Martial Intent] — skip the initial Charged Attack and go straight into empowered [Severed Grace]. At R2+: Enemy Weakness is extended, giving more burst time. At R3+: [Sundering Thrust] has shorter cooldown and [Ashen Duskfall] deals more damage.

silverwing_fiend.paragraph_1: Silverwing Fiend is a resource-building burst transformation companion. You absorb [Blood Essence] through attacks to fill a 100-point gauge. When full, cast [Blood Pact] to enter [Crimson Bond] — Sylus becomes your familiar, your skills transform, and you unleash massive DEF-scaling damage through [Bloodroses] and [Underworld Rift].
silverwing_fiend.paragraph_2: You have two main resources to track:
silverwing_fiend.ul_li_1: [Blood Essence] — main resource (0-100), filled by attacks and skills
silverwing_fiend.ul_li_2: [Rose Mark] — buff that empowers Charged Attacks; recovers over time
silverwing_fiend.ul_li_3: [Bloodrose] — damage amp stacks (max 2) from blooming seeds during Bond
silverwing_fiend.paragraph_4: When [Blood Essence] is full (100), the [Blood Pact] button lights up — press it to enter [Crimson Bond].
silverwing_fiend.paragraph_5: Pro tip: Use [Crimson Coffin] on cooldown — it's your biggest single source of [Blood Essence].
silverwing_fiend.rotationstring: [Charged Attack] → [Crimson Break] → [Basic Attack] → [Crimson Coffin] → repeat until 100 [Blood Essence]
silverwing_fiend.li_1: [Basic Attack] (full combo) → absorbs 3 [Blood Essence] per hit
silverwing_fiend.li_2: [Charged Attack] → consumes [Rose Mark] → triggers [Rose Thorns] (+12 Essence)
silverwing_fiend.li_4: [Crimson Coffin] ([Resonance Skill]) → absorbs +20 Essence + gathers enemies
silverwing_fiend.paragraph_7: Build to 100 [Blood Essence] as quickly as possible, then use [Blood Pact] to enter [Crimson Bond].
silverwing_fiend.paragraph_8: Crimson Bond (Burst): During [Crimson Bond], your skills change:
silverwing_fiend.rotationstring2: Attack to stimulate [Bloodrose Seed] → grow [Bloodroses] (max 2) → [Bloodrose Rain] (buff) → [Underworld Rift] (detonate)
silverwing_fiend.paragraph_9: Inside [Crimson Bond]: keep attacking to grow [Bloodroses]. Each [Bloodrose] increases [Underworld Rift] detonation damage by 30%. Wait for 2 [Bloodroses] before detonating for maximum damage.
silverwing_fiend.paragraph_10: [Ardent Oath] — [Crimson Finale] — is best used during [Crimson Bond] for maximum damage:
silverwing_fiend.li_10: At R2: [Blood Spell] debuff increases enemy DMG taken by 8%
silverwing_fiend.li_11: At R3: Sylus deals 10% more DMG during Bond
silverwing_fiend.li_12: At R3: Casting [Active Skill] grants [Bloodrose Wreath] (+10% DMG for 8s). Wreath fires extra bullets on Basic/Charged attacks that grow [Bloodrose Seed] faster — making it easier to reach 2 Bloodroses before detonation.
silverwing_fiend.rotationstring3: Setup: Charged Attack → Crimson Break → Basic Attack →  Crimson Coffin → repeat to 100 Essence → Blood Pact → Crimson Bond → Burst: Attack → grow Bloodrose #1 → Attack → grow Bloodrose #2 → Bloodrose Rain → Underworld Rift → detonate → repeat

farspace_colonel.paragraph_1: Farspace Colonel's gameplay has two main phases: Outside and Inside [Battlefront]

notabene.li_1: It is important to notice that companing to other companions, Farspace Colonel's Shiled Breaking mechanic is a bit different though it is as always connected to the [Resonance Skill]. Usually when we're not having full [Stellactrum Match], we're only able to break one layer, FC is breaking 2 layers. And in the same way when we are breaking 2 layers on full [Stellactrum Match], FC breaks 4 layers. The reason behind it is that his [Resonance Skill] should be unlocked first in order to use it and it takes two times more time to do so.

farspace_colonel.paragraph_3:
Goal: Reach 100 [Firepower] to unlock [Deep Strike].
Priority skills to use:

ol_1.li_2: [Particle Beam] (Support Skill) → restores 5 Firepower + deals damage
ol_1.li_3: [Air Strike] (Active Skill) → restores 2 Firepower + calls air strikes
ol_1.li_4: Dodge → gain 10 [Zerom] → basic attacks consume Zerom to restore extra Firepower

farspace_colonel.paragraph_4: Pro tip: Use [Air Strike] with 2+ Energy for bonus damage.
farspace_colonel.paragraph_6:
When [Firepower] hits 100 → [Deep Strike] button glows → press it.
What changes:

ul_1.li_4: Final hit of basic attacks applies [Focus] marks (max 3)

farspace_colonel.paragraph_8: Goal: Stack 3 [Focus] marks → cast [Ground Breach] for maximum damage.

burst_rotation.li_3: Cast [Air Strike] ([Active Skill]) for extra damage
burst_rotation.li_4: [Ground Breach] → snipe enemies → damage scales with [Focus] marks

farspace_colonel.paragraph_10: At R3 when [Focus] marks exceed the limit (3+), an extra gravity vortex spawns, dealing bonus damage. [Basic Attack] final hit grants an additional [Focus] mark — making it easier to trigger the vortex.

ul_3.li_1: R3 loop: Basic → extra Focus → vortex triggers → more damage

farspace_colonel.paragraph_12: As a Standard Myth Companion, Farspace Colonel doesn't really have a strict rotation, as long as you build enough [Firepower] to activate [Battlefront]. Ideally we can follow the next sequence of actions:

full_rotation.li_1: OUTSIDE [BATTLEFRONT]: [Basic Attack] (restores [Firepower]) → [Particle Beam] (+5 [Firepower]) → [Air Strike] (+2 [Firepower]) → Dodge (gain [Zerom]) → [Basic Attack] (consume [Zerom] for extra [Firepower]) → repeat until 100 [Firepower]
full_rotation.li_3: INSIDE [BATTLEFRONT]: [Basic Attack] (full combo) → apply [Focus] mark → [Air Strike] (if off cooldown) → [Particle Beam] → [Basic Attack] → [Focus] mark #2 → [Basic Attack] → [Focus] mark #3 → [Ground Breach] → snipe with max [Focus] damage

netherlord.paragraph_1: Netherlord is one of the most mechanically demanding companions — proper timing and input (tap vs hold) matter a lot. He has two phases: Neutral (building resources) and Union (burst damage). Your goal is to enter Union as often as possible by triggering [Blooms].
netherlord.paragraph_2: Enemies get two halves of a lotus mark (Yin = red, Yang = blue). When both halves meet → [Bloom] triggers:

table_1.table_row_3_applies: Applies the missing half → triggers Bloom
table_1.table_row_4_applies: Applies a half (prioritizes the missing one)

netherlord.paragraph_4: When you enter [Sword Stance] (after [Active Skill] or 3rd basic attack), look at the enemy's flower:
netherlord.rotationstring: Short version: [Support Skill] & [Active Skill] → tap/hold → [Charged Attack] → 3x [Basic Attack]s → tap/hold → [Active Skill] → tap/hold → [Support Skill]
netherlord.li_1: [Support Skill] → applies a half (prioritizes the missing one)
netherlord.li_2: [Active Skill] → gives you a [Lotus Seed] + enters [Sword Stance]
netherlord.li_3: Tap/HOLD (based on flower color) → applies correct half
netherlord.li_4: [Charged Attack] → consumes Seed → applies missing half → guarantees BLOOM #1
netherlord.li_5: 3x [Basic Attacks] → final hit applies random half
netherlord.li_6: Tap/HOLD again (from [Sword Stance]) → applies matching half → BLOOM #2
netherlord.li_9: [Support Skill] or [Charged Attack] → completes the next Bloom
netherlord.paragraph_7: Trigger Blooms as quickly as possible to reduce [Yin-Yang Cycle] cooldown and enter Union. This rotation is a baseline; in practice you can adjust based on cooldowns or replace some Bloom triggers with [Soulguide Bell].
netherlord.paragraph_9: Once in Union, your skills change:
netherlord.rotationstring2: [Spectral Slash] (opens Rift) → [Azure Ballad] (costs 1 Energy; makes next free) → [Charged Attack] (bonus damage; at R3 even higher)
netherlord.paragraph_10: Each Rift makes your next [Azure Ballad] free, allowing you to chain skills and extend your rotation.
netherlord.paragraph_11: [Ardent Oath] is best used during the enemy’s weakened state (after breaking their shield), and [Fate Unforgotten] is no exception, but it has its own mechanics. During the animation: 3 [Dustbreak] buttons appear. Tap each at the right moment:
netherlord.li_10: Each perfect = 5% Max HP heal to you and Caleb
netherlord.paragraph_12: At R3: This ultimate can crit is a huge damage increase.

mc_icons.caption: Only MC gets icons in battle with Netherlord. They can be found right above MC's HP bar. Icon in blue shows that Union Phase is up, in pink - in possesion of a Seed, in green - Sword Stance.

lotus.caption: The flower can be seen directly on the enemy during the battle. Red Yin half is at the bottom, while Blue Yang half is placed at the top.

rift.caption: In Union Phase you will see rifts instead of flowers

oath.caption: Tap on each button during Oath animation to get all the buffs
